title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee) good to go, will play Rams on Thursday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee) is good to go against the Rams on Thursday. He's been practicing in a limited fashion, and though his return to play had been reported and expected, he carries no injury designation for this games.
items.impact: This is great news for Niners fans and those in IDP leagues with Bosa. He should be an anchor to that defense in a very important Week 1 for the Niners.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: George Kittle off injury report, active for Thursday
items.desc: George Kittle is off the 49ers injury report and is active for their game against the Rams in Melbourne.
items.impact: Kittle is a day under nine months since his Achilles tear, and now will complete his improbable comeback by playing in the Niners season opener. Expect him to have a decent workload, though don't be surprised if the Niners limit his snaps a bit. He's crucial for their long term success, so they'll need to keep him fresh and available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Darnold (hip) avoids fracture, to undergo MRI Thursday
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said the team got good initial news on Sam Darnold and they have ruled out a fracture.
items.impact: Darnold was ruled out for the night in the opening drive on Wednesday. He is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Thursday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) ruled out against Seattle
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of the Patriots game against Seattle.
items.impact: Brown went down in the second half after a Seattle DB landed on his ankle, and Brown went back to the locker room soon after for x-rays. The Patriots will lean on Romeo Doubs, Pop Douglas, and Hunter Henry in the passing game with him out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran offensive lineman has had plenty of injury struggles throughout his career, but it looks like he will start out this season healthy, as he was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday. His expected presence will be great for QB Jaxson Dart and RB Cam Skattebo, both of whom will need a sturdy offensive line if they are going to reach their fantasy ceiling this year.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Theo Johnson (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Theo Johnson (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: It looks like the Giants will have Johnson available to play for them on Sunday, as he was able to log a full practice to start the week on Wednesday. He won't carry any fantasy value himself but should serve as a nice depth option for Jaxson Dart moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson (head) off injury report for Week 1
items.desc: Wan'Dale Robinson (head) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 1's matchup against the New York Jets.
items.impact: As expected, Robinson's head injury is no longer an issue and he carries no injury designation heading into Week 1. He should be a full go against the Jets and projects to be a worthwhile streaming option in PPR formats.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Downs (calf) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Josh Downs (calf) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Downs is not listed on Indianapolis' injury report heading into Week 1, meaning that his calf injury is no longer an issue and that he should be at full health at this point. Indianapolis' distribution of targets should be something fantasy managers keep a close eye on this weekend, but the 25-year old isn't projected to be a strong fantasy asset on his own to start the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mitchell was sidelined for a while as he dealt with a hamstring injury, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. He will have a chance to play in Week 1, but even if he's active, he's not expected to play more than a depth role for the Chargers in their matchup against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (hip) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (hip) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was unable to log a full practice session on Wednesday due to a hip injury that he's dealing with. He has a chance to see the field on Sunday if active, but if he's ruled out, his absence will lead to a bit more work for Tre' Harris against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) inactive for Week 1
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) is inactive for Week 1 for the Seattle Seahawks against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Emmanwori will be sidelined for the season opener after struggling to log practice time early in the week, leaving the Seattle secondary shorthanded against New England quarterback Drake Maye and the Patriots offense Wednesday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) without injury designation for Thursday
items.desc: Myles Garrett (knee) is without an injury designation for Thursday night's game against the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: The star defender will be available to play for the Rams on Thursday night, despite still dealing with a minor knee issue of some kind. His highly-anticipated debut for his new team will come at a great time for the Rams in what projects to be a tough matchup against the 49ers in their season opener.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (finger) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk (finger) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran fullback logged a limited practice for a second-straight day on Wednesday. If he plays on Thursday, he won't have any fantasy relevance himself, but his presence in the lineup would help Christian McCaffrey to be more efficient and effective on the ground.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: It looks like Jeanty is strongly trending towards playing in Week 1, as he was able to put up a full session in Las Vegas' first practice of the week on Wednesday. If he is active, he will likely see enough work to be a great fantasy option in a positive matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tee Higgins (foot) fully participates in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tee Higgins (foot) fully participated in Cincinnati's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Higgins is still listed on Cincinnati's injury report due to a nagging foot injury, but it's not a serious issue at this point and he was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 1 and projects to be a good fantasy option against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Chase was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday and is considered close to full health, if not already fully healthy heading into Week 1. He should be a full go against the Buccaneers and projects to be an elite fantasy option in the season opener and beyond.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sean Tucker (hamstring) officially a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Sean Tucker (hamstring) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tucker was not spotted during Tampa Bay's practice on Wednesday, and he turned out to be a non-participant due to a hamstring injury that he's dealing with. If he is sidelined in Week 1, Kenny Gainwell will see more opportunities as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (toe) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young stud wideout was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, which means that his toe injury is likely fully healed at this point. He should play in Week 1 and is expected to be a good fantasy option in a great matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen McMillan (knee) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McMillan's knee injury is still not fully healed, so he remained a limited participant at practice on Wednesday as a result. If he is sidelined for Week 1, Ted Hurst III will be primed for more work in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordan Morgan (knee) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jordan Morgan (knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Morgan's knee injury left him limited at the team's practice on Wednesday. He is expected to be their starting left tackle this season, so if he misses any time, QB Jordan Love and RB MarShawn Lloyd will both be affected by that in a big way.
